Youth Confronts BJP MLA Over Reservation Demand, Calls Him 'Donkey'

During a protest in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, demanding 27% OBC reservation, a youth confronted BJP MLA Devendra Jain. When the MLA asked if he was a donkey, the youth responded, "Yes, you are a donkey, I am a graduate." A video of the heated exchange went viral.
